Adjacent IZ pairs with firing-range features

Source: R/izone_adjacency.R
make_adjacent_pairs.Rd

Order IZs by chromosome (seqlevel order), start and end, attach the firing range of each IZ (matched by iz_id) and build all adjacent pairs on the same chromosome with distances and firing-range overlaps.

Usage

make_adjacent_pairs(izones, fire_ranges)

Arguments

izones

GRanges of IZs with an iz_id column.

fire_ranges

Output of calculate_firing_range() (iz_id, earliest_rep_percent, latest_unrep_percent, optionally corroborated), with the same coordinates for matching ids.

Value

A list with izones (ordered), features (one row per IZ) and pairs (one row per adjacent pair: indices into features, ids, coordinates, center_distance_bp, gap_bp, overlap_bp, left/right firing-range columns, firing_range_overlap, earliest_rep_difference).

Details

A firing range is valid when both bounds are finite, earliest >= 0, latest <= 1 and earliest <= latest; firing_range_overlap is computed for pairs with two valid ranges.
